text: Quick, God, I need your helping hand! The last decent person just went down, All the friends I depended on gone.
Lies slide off their oily lips. They doubletalk with forked tongues.
The braggart tongues from their mouths!
Into the dark streets where the homeless groan, God speaks: "I've had enough; I'm on my way To heal the ache in the heart of the wretched."
Pure silver words refined seven times In the fires of his word-kiln, Pure on earth as well as in heaven.
From the wicked who stalk us with lies,
